title: OTP delivery and NIN/BVN lookup hardening (identity batch 1: ONA-ID-101, 203, 205)

requirements.expectation: In production isDemoOtpAllowed() is true only when OTP_DEMO_MODE or NEXT_PUBLIC_OTP_DEMO_MODE is exactly true or 1; unset, empty, false and masked values are false. Outside production it stays true.
evidence: code: src/lib/auth/__tests__/demo-otp.test.ts covers unset, false, 0, yes, masked and blank values (off) and true/TRUE/1 on either flag (on); 14 cases pass.

requirements.expectation: When OTP delivery fails and demo mode is not allowed, POST /api/auth/otp/send returns 502 otp_delivery_failed, does not leak the provider error, writes nothing to phone_otps and does not consume earlier codes.
requirements.verification: Route test with a failing SMS provider and a failing email sender.
evidence: code: src/app/api/auth/otp/send/__tests__/route.test.ts asserts 502, error code, no provider text in the message and zero phone_otps writes for both channels.

requirements.expectation: With the email sender configured an email OTP is a random code (not the demo code), is emailed, and only then stored. With no provider and no demo mode both channels return 503 otp_delivery_unavailable and store nothing. The demo path is unchanged while demo mode is on.
evidence: code: src/app/api/auth/otp/send/__tests__/route.test.ts asserts the emailed code differs from the demo code and is stored under the email key; 503 for phone and email with no provider; demo delivery kept when demo mode is on.

requirements.expectation: With no provider key in production the NIN and BVN lookups return ok:false with code NOT_CONFIGURED and the routes answer 503. Outside production the format-only pass is unchanged.
requirements.verification: Unit test of src/lib/server/prembly.ts and route test.
evidence: code: src/lib/server/__tests__/prembly.test.ts asserts NOT_CONFIGURED in production with no network call, and the format pass in development.
code: src/app/api/verify/__tests__/id-lookup-routes.test.ts asserts 503 for NOT_CONFIGURED and 422 for a provider rejection.

requirements.expectation: Both lookup routes call the shared limiter per IP and per kind before the provider. An exhausted budget returns 429 with Retry-After; a limiter outage returns 503; the provider is not called in either case. The routes stay unauthenticated.
requirements.verification: Route test against the deployed-mode limiter with a stubbed Redis reply.
evidence: code: src/app/api/verify/__tests__/id-lookup-routes.test.ts asserts 429 + Retry-After, 503 on outage, provider untouched, and different limiter keys for different caller IPs.

requirements.expectation: The full local check suite passes.
requirements.verification: npm test, npm run lint, npm run typecheck, npm run check:server-boundaries, npm run check:openapi-drift.
evidence: code: 222 Vitest files (1,970 tests) pass; eslint 0 errors (143 warnings, none in changed files); tsc --noEmit exits 0; check:server-boundaries verified; check:openapi-drift ok (187 route files, none missing).

requirements.expectation: On the deployed app the demo code is rejected when the flag is off, real SMS and email codes arrive, and NIN/BVN lookups work with the provider key.
requirements.verification: Live QA on the hosted environment.

code: Contact-change codes (src/lib/server/security/security-store.ts, src/app/api/security/action/route.ts) still generate and deliver their own codes; give them the same deliver-or-fail behaviour.
Second SMS provider with failover and a NIN lookup cache (batch 3).
Server-side NIN/BVN lookup with a stored result; nin_verified/bvn_verified are still set as before (batch 2).
external: Before merge: set OTP_DEMO_MODE=true explicitly on the host unless live SMS and email delivery are confirmed, otherwise OTP login is locked out.
Set the SMS provider keys and RESEND_API_KEY / RESEND_FROM_EMAIL (verified sending domain) on the host for real code delivery.
Set the ID provider key on the host; without it production NIN/BVN checks at signup return 503.
Independent human review against the implementation commit.
